# Room Ready Supply

> Room Ready Supply is a wholesale supplier of hospitality and facility products -- towels, bed linens, paper products, cleaning chemicals, trash liners, guest amenities, gloves/PPE, and pillows/mattress protectors -- sold by the case to hotels, vacation rentals, restaurants, healthcare facilities, and cleaning companies across the United States. Pricing is tiered by case quantity (standard, 6+ cases, 30+ cases) and shown directly on every product page; no account is required to see pricing or place an order.

## Core pages

- [Catalog](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/catalog): Full product catalog, filterable by category.
- [Best Deals](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/best-deals): Currently discounted products.
- [About Us](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/#about-us): Company background, based in Plymouth, North Carolina, serving the East Coast and shipping nationwide.
- [Shipping Policy](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/shipping-policy): Shipping origin, carriers, processing times, and delivery areas.

- [How Much Toilet Paper & Paper Towels Should a Hotel Stock Per Room?](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/blog/post?slug=how-much-toilet-paper-should-a-hotel-stock): Formula for sizing a paper products order by room count and occupancy.
- [Bath Towel Buying Guide for Vacation Rentals & Boutique Hotels](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/blog/post?slug=bath-towel-buying-guide-vacation-rentals-boutique-hotels): GSM, cotton grade, and case sizing for commercial-durability towel buying.
- [Trash Liner Sizing Guide: Picking the Right Can Liner for Every Bin](https://www.roomreadysupply.com/blog/post?slug=trash-liner-sizing-guide-right-can-liner-every-bin): Matching liner size and gauge to bin size and use case.
